_comment: TEAM MUST CONFIRM THIS MAPPING: it determines every E1 and E2 number.
Groups are the scoring units for E1. Classes not listed here are IGNORED.
prompt_to_group maps detector prompt labels to those groups. The prompts
'person' and 'face' both predict the person group because COCO-Stuff has
no face class; 'vegetation' and 'tree' both predict vegetation.
Class names must match the COCO-Stuff label-name file exactly.
Domains must be one of: people, nature, urban, animals.
